records.title: Towards Accessible Legal AI: A Hierarchical Transformer-Based Approach for Summarizing Long Indian Legal and Policy Documents
records.reason: The primary abstract studies hierarchical summarization of Indian legal and governmental documents with BART; this is a domain application, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Early Exit Neural Networks: A Comparative Study Against Static Models and Dynamic Models Across Multi-Domain Datasets
records.reason: The abstract compares generic DNN early exit on CIFAR-10, AG News, and Dry Bean; it does not evaluate LLMs or LLM serving.

records.title: Research on the TSM-Transformer Algorithm for Network Traffic Forecast
records.reason: The paper proposes a Transformer for network-traffic forecasting and evaluates forecast accuracy, not LLM inference.
